text: どうだい　かうかね？

patterns.name: 〜だい
patterns.explanation: だい after a question word is a friendly way of asking, used mostly by older men. どうだい = 'how about it?'

patterns.name: 〜かね
patterns.explanation: かね is a question ending used by older men talking to someone younger; it is softer than a bare か. かうかね = 'will you buy it, hm?'
